Hi Taylor — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A couple of items before we can push PO into the finance queue: 

- We attempted an automated TIN match against the EIN you provided; it did not return a positive match in our cross-check (returns 'no match').
- For non-US entities submitting W-8BEN-E, our standard acceptable evidence is one of: IRS CP575/147C (official IRS letter confirming EIN), a government-issued tax agency confirmation, or a copy of the original IRS issuance docs.
- In lieu of CP575/147C, we can consider a bank EIN confirmation letter only when it's accompanied by a signed attestation from an officer confirming the EIN and authority to sign. The attestation should reference the EIN and the W-8BEN-E document.

Would you be able to provide: 1) the signed attestation (vendor_attestation.docx) and 2) a completed supplier onboarding questionnaire (I've attached our questionnaire template vendor_onboarding_questionnaire.pdf for any missing fields)? Once we have both, I'll route to Finance for an exception review — Lauren will confirm whether the bank letter plus attestation suffices for PO activation.

If you can provide a CP575/147C instead that will speed the process.

Best,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Procurement Manager

Team — reviewed the bank letter and the signed attestation. Per Redwood finance policy for international entities, a CP575/147C is preferred but not strictly mandatory when two independent corroborating items are present: (1) bank-issued EIN confirmation and (2) signed corporate attestation referencing the EIN. The questionnaire completes our onboarding fields.

Decision: Approve conditional PO creation (internal PO staging) pending Treasury spot-check. Rishi, please create the PO in staging and mark it "conditional - tax evidence pending final archival." Once Treasury completes the spot check (target within 5 business days) we will flip to active and release funds. Taylor — please expect a DocuSign for the attestation if Treasury requests a stamped/emailed copy; I'll loop you if needed.

Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance Operations
